meta.name: ai-ml-governance
meta.description: Governs models and AI systems in production — intended use, evaluation, monitoring, human oversight, documentation, and the decision to deploy or retire. Use this before deploying a model or AI feature, when defining evaluation criteria, when a model's behavior has drifted, when assessing AI risk or regulatory exposure, or when deciding whether an AI system is fit for a consequential decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规范AI模型治理,把控上线风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责AI系统的合规与风险评估
copy.tagline_en: Govern AI models with clear oversight
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own AI compliance and risk decisions

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 AI 治理流程来检查你的模型:明确用途与后果等级,核对评估、监控、人工监督、文档和退役机制,并提醒法律与风险、给出是否适合部署的判断。
howto.when: 当你准备部署 AI 功能、定义评估标准,或发现模型行为漂移时,Claude 会启动治理流程;评估 AI 或监管风险、决定是否用于重大决策时也一样。

say.text: 新模型上线前,帮我列出治理要求清单。
这个模型对某类人群表现偏差,帮我设计按分段的评估指标。
模型漂移了,给我一个监控和人工复核计划。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through AI governance: define intended use, pick a consequence tier (advisory/assistive/autonomous), then review evaluation, monitoring, human oversight, documentation, retirement, and flag legal/risk.
howto.when_en: Triggers before deploying a model or AI feature, when defining evaluation criteria, when a model's behavior drifts, or when assessing AI/regulatory risk or fitness for a consequential decision.

say_en.text: Before launch, help me list governance requirements for this model.
say_en.note: Covers evaluation, monitoring, oversight, docs, retirement.

say_en.text: This model is worse for one group; design segmented evaluation metrics.
say_en.note: It asks for segment data and cost of both error directions.

say_en.text: The model drifted; give me a monitoring and human-review plan.
say_en.note: Checks input drift and override rate; plans fallback.
